subject: Will multi-threading in inla conflict with intel MKL in Microsoft R open?

messages.author: 80b903b54c9cf4bd
messages.subject: Will multi-threading in inla conflict with intel MKL in Microsoft R open?
parts:
Hi,

I have been using Microsoft R open for a while since it has a built in MKL for parallel matrix computation. I am on a desktop with 4 physical cores. When I do matrix calculations, my task manager will show I am using 50% of all my CPU. The number of cores for MKL is set to be 4.

I started to use INLA recently and notice that after the model began to fit, my CPU usage will shoot to 100%. I had experience that when I tried to do embarrassing parallel with MKL, since MKL has implicit parallel underneath, those two levels of parallel processing will compete with each other. Thus my code ran even much slower.

My question is, will INLA's built in parallel be conflict with MKL's implicit parallel? I'm asking this since the modeling fitting process has stopped for a while with no verbose printed out.

Thanks!

messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Will multi-threading in inla conflict with intel MKL in Microsoft R open?
parts:
I don’t think so. R-INLA does very few computations in R. Once the inla processes have started, nothing is done in R until they finish. 

If the program is hanging like that, it might be a memory issue. Try reducing the number of threads inla uses to 1. This reduced memory massively. 

D
